(Silvo's pirates) |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Ishi Tib]]{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{AD|Disney+}} |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Gold]] {{C|right [[eye]] missing}} |skin=Green |cyber=[[Cybernetics|Cybernetic]] eye{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Silvo's pirates]] |masters= |apprentices= }} An [[Ishi Tib]] '''pirate''' was a member of a [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Originally serving under [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]], he switched his allegiance after a mutiny elevated [[Brutus]] as the new leader. With his [[eye]] lost during a [[Silvo's pirate raid|raid]] on a [[Unidentified bulk freighter (New Republic Era)|merchant freighter]], the Ishi Tib underwent a surgery to replace the missing organ with a [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] prosthetic. Equipped with a new replacement, he subsequently took part in the [[Invasion of At Attin]]. ==Biography== ===The eye lost=== An [[Ishi Tib]] [[pirate]] was a member of [[Silvo's pirates|Silvo's crew]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Around [[9 BBY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} he took part in a [[Silvo's pirate raid|raid]] on a [[Unidentified bulk freighter (New Republic Era)|bulk freighter]] crewed by [[New Republic]] [[merchant]]s. Finding himself in the second wave of invaders, the Ishi Tib made it aboard alive, passing by the [[Death|dead]] corpses of some of his comrades. Upon boarding, the [[pirate]] was shot in his right [[eye]]stalk, an injury he quickly shrugged off before [[Blaster|gunning]] down the [[Unidentified merchant crewman|crewman]] who had deprived him of the eye. Although the bulk [[freighter]] was successfully intercepted, the shipment the pirates were after proved insufficient compared to the loss of lives they suffered. A subsequent mutiny against [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] established [[Brutus]] as the new leader.{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} ===A cyborg implant=== [[File:PirateSurgery.png|thumb|right|250px|The pirate receives an eye replacement.]] Under the new leadership, the pirates traveled to [[Borgo Prime]], where the Ishi Tib had a [[cyborg]]{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} {{AD|Disney+}} eye welded onto his injured eyestalk. As another individual carried out the surgery inside a kiosk, the Ishi Tib cried in pain, flailing the medical equipment in the process. In the meantime, Brutus's pirates had a run in with the [[Skeleton Crew]],{{SWYouTube|T19XifsgFS0|Skeleton Crew | Blast from the Past | Streaming Dec 2 on Disney+}} which comprised four [[youngling]] who had accidentally left their [[homeworld]] and found themselves lost in [[the galaxy]]. Because the children claimed to hail from the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] and had an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] on them, Brutus ordered arresting them. When locked in a [[brig]], the Skeleton Crew joined forces with former Captain Silvo, who gave credence to their story and together with them escaped to their [[starship]]. However, Silvo soon found that the [[vessel]] was stuck on a fuel line, significantly constraining his room for maneuver. Meanwhile, Brutus and his crew—including the Ishi Tib—gathered on the landing platform. The captain ordered using a [[cannon]], but before it could hit Silvo's starship, the former captain jumped into [[hyperspace]] and sent the snapped fuel line bouncing back on the platform. As the [[asteroid]] drowned in chaos,{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{AD|Disney+}} the Ishi Tib narrowly avoided danger when a loose scaffolding collapsed right in front of him. ==Personality and traits== A member of the Ishi Tib [[species]], the pirate had [[Color|green]] skin and two eyestalks protruding from the head. After he lost his right eye, he had an cybernetic implant welded into his injured eyestalk. During the surgery, he dealt with pain by flailing medical equipment. ==Equipment== The Ishi Tib pirated sported a brown [[Clothing|coat]] with a beige shirt underneath. After he lost one of his eyes, he underwent a surgery to receive a cybernetic replacement. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:PiratesOnSet.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Jaleel White]] (Gunter), [[Stephen Oyoung]] (Brutus), and a performance artist (the Ishi Tib) on set]] The [[Ishi Tib]] [[pirate]] was first pictured in the trailer of the upcoming live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' on [[November 1]], [[2024]].{{SWYouTube|f19gfOMZTtg|Skeleton Crew | Official Trailer | Disney+}} He made his [[canon]]ical debut on [[December 2]], [[2024]],{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}} when he appeared in the two premiere episodes of the series, "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]" and "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]."
